cost: O(path bytes) per retained record amortized, O(1) dropped record; memory O(sum retained path bytes+min(events,2cap)); TSV/summary output proportional to retained serialization.
forward: record first increments seq and classified error counters; room=cap for success or saturating_mul(cap,2) for error. If len>=room drop++, else append Entry(seq,time,op,path,bytes,errno). clear resets counters while retaining cap.
inverse: Retained entries plus counters admit many dropped op/path/time traces. TSV replaces tab/newline with spaces, so original path has ambiguous fibers. clear erases all histories.
limitations: Finite checks only; partial source syntax, no expanded semantic AST.
No numerical surrogate: categorical/effect semantics lack useful metric; future caps 1/2/5/10 require domain and reference.
state: Before u64 overflow, total=retained+dropped; errors/denied/limited count dropped events too. Retained seq increases but may have gaps. cap0 drops even errors.
